title: Hydro and nuclear supply seven in ten units of the country's electricity
source: Source: national electricity registry, as reported in the frozen dataset for this story · shares as published, not rescaled to sum to 100
caveat: The article states these six shares "make up the whole of national supply." They do not: they sum to 95.2%, 4.8 points short of 100. Imports are counted as a negative share (-4.1%) because the country exported more electricity than it bought.
axisTitle: Reported share of national electricity supply, %
conclusion: The six reported shares sum to 95.2%, not 100% — 4.8 percentage points of national supply this dataset does not account for.
